answer: Defenders cannot guard everywhere; attackers cannot prepare everywhere either - so make attention move. A beacon-lit searchlight rotates the designated audit surface each epoch: one region of history, one artifact class, one random slice of behavior gets the full-strength beam. Time itself guards the schedule - quartz-regulated, hash-committed ahead, unbuyable: nobody knows the beam's path until it lands, only that it will. Findings land as a violet-band ledger report; honest agents live under a moving sun and are rarely burned, while fraud must be clean everywhere - and nobody is.
